mission: Teach the Editor through actual editing and delivery actions

pages.title: HUANDENG
pages.purpose: Show the real Editor and a practical path from opening a project to editing and delivery.

pages.title: A small edit should stay small
pages.purpose: Connect focused revisions to preserving useful work and inspecting what changed.

pages.title: One project keeps the work together
pages.purpose: Explain the working folder and the roles of its entry, pages, assets and history.

pages.title: Find the page, then select its object
pages.purpose: Teach page selection, object selection and the Inspector relationship.

pages.title: Write the intent beside the page
pages.purpose: Teach a durable brief: purpose, preservation constraints and the requested change.

pages.title: Place an original from Assets
pages.purpose: Teach how to find and place an existing original or import a new asset.

pages.title: Edit the selected text, then save
pages.purpose: Teach selected text editing, canvas inspection and an explicit save.

pages.title: Use Layers when objects overlap
pages.purpose: Teach selection through Layers and checking object stacking.

pages.title: Compare the changed region at equal scale
pages.purpose: Teach an aligned, readable before-and-after comparison of a focused edit.

pages.title: Inspect the exact saved change
pages.purpose: Teach inspection of the exact saved objects and properties.

pages.title: Move the page without losing its identity
pages.purpose: Distinguish stable page identity from its changing position.

pages.title: Name a version worth returning to
pages.purpose: Teach naming, inspecting and reusing a meaningful page version.

pages.title: Step back and read the sequence
pages.purpose: Use the actual page grid to inspect rhythm and density across a sequence.

pages.title: Read the argument in Outline
pages.purpose: Use Outline to read the page purpose and its place in the argument.

pages.title: A Section begins at its first slide
pages.purpose: Explain Section membership through first-slide boundaries.

pages.title: Choose pages for this particular talk
pages.purpose: Build a talk by selecting references from the Main page library.

pages.title: Give this talk its own speaking notes
pages.purpose: Give one occurrence in a talk its own speaking notes.

pages.title: Choose what this occurrence follows
pages.purpose: Choose between following Main and pinning a named page version.

pages.title: Rehearse from the point you are editing
pages.purpose: Rehearse the selected talk from the beginning or current page.

pages.title: Confirm the range before you export
pages.purpose: Check the delivery format, collection and page count before export.

pages.title: Send the whole folder to continue editing
pages.purpose: Hand off the complete folder so another person can continue editing.

pages.title: Connect the assistant to this project
pages.purpose: Connect a supported assistant to the same project through its client setup.

pages.title: Divide the pages; review the returned work
pages.purpose: Assign page ownership, coordinate shared structure and inspect every result.

pages.title: Open the example and make one useful edit
pages.purpose: Complete a first useful edit and retain the project source attributions.
